name: Common brushtail possum
_note: Numbers are first-pass placeholders for the director to tune. Facts are draft text, to be checked against sources before release. Brushtails are mostly solitary, so they have no company need.

needs.label: Food
needs.issue: Hungry: no eucalypts close to its den

issue_parts.shelter: No den: no nest box or hollow close by

facts: Brushtail possums sleep through the day in tree hollows, and come out to feed at night.
A eucalypt can take 100 years or more to form hollows big enough for a possum.
Where old hollow trees have been cleared, nest boxes give possums somewhere safe to den.
They eat mostly eucalypt leaves, plus flowers, fruit and buds.
Brushtail possums mostly live alone, and mark their home range with scent.
They get much of the water they need from the leaves they eat.
